policy:
# Meta Ads Policy — v0 (seed, identical for every sim world)

GOAL this policy serves: maximize settled ROAS (revenue / spend) for a $29/mo
product ("Formflow"); purchases are the goal event.

## Creative
Run three video ads per batch. The words may lead with any angle the writer
judges best (no earned bias yet). Declared angle families: benefit, outcome,
count (adoption numbers), story (named customer). A demo variant (screen-
recording of the product working) is an available production option, untested.

## Campaigns
Standard cold-start portfolio per batch, $200 total: a pageviews campaign
(broad), a leads campaign (broad), sales campaigns, and optionally an
auto-budget sales campaign (platform allocates between audiences).
Audiences available: broad, interest_biztools, interest_niche.

## Judgment
Judge only settled results. An ad/cell with no measurement is unknown, not
bad. Never repeat an approach that measurably failed. Unreadable cells
(starved/short-window) are evidence of nothing.

## Process
After each batch, the semantic gradient reads all receipts and revises this
policy; a noise schedule picks the revision dose. Every batch's full receipts
accumulate as evidence.
design_thesis: With no prior settled-purchase evidence, use the seed portfolio to establish broad pageview and lead baselines while measuring purchases directly across all three available sales audiences. Creative exploration spans a product-working demo, a follow-up/status outcome, and reusable-template/plan-capacity framing; all claims and trial terms match the landing page.

Parent: v0.

GOAL: maximize settled purchase ROAS for Formflow; purchases are the goal event.

Creative default: Exactly three video ads run per batch, each using verified Formflow functionality and Start Free Trial. The initial set is ad_demo_workflow (intake-to-status-board product demo), ad_outcome_followup (missing-detail follow-up and visibility outcome), and ad_count_templates (reusable templates, branded link, unlimited forms, 500 records, two team members). Trial copy is 14-day trial and $29/month after trial. Creative selection is coverage-led, not taste-led: retain these three families until each has $300 cumulative protected funding; then allocate the first eligible slot to the untested story family before refining any funded family.

Portfolio default: Spend $455 per batch in fixed campaigns: pageviews_broad, pageviews, broad, $40, ad_ids [ad_demo_workflow]; leads_broad, leads, broad, $40, ad_ids [ad_outcome_followup]; sales_broad, sales, broad, $125, ad_ids [ad_demo_workflow]; sales_biztools, sales, interest_biztools, $125, ad_ids [ad_outcome_followup]; sales_niche, sales, interest_niche, $125, ad_ids [ad_count_templates]. Every sales campaign has exactly one eligible ad. The next sales ad_id for a campaign is the highest-priority unpriced creative-audience combination permitted by the ledger; this changes no claim or audience without a corresponding explicit campaign assignment.

Evidence and judgment: The question-opening purchase rate was 2 purchases on $199.95. Therefore every open purchase-cell question carries a fixed $100 readability floor and fixed $300 demotion floor; these values never change with later performance. Accumulate spend by exact sales objective, exact audience, and exact ad/family. Before $100, classify the cell UNTESTED. At or above $100, compare only settled purchase ROAS in like-for-like sales cells. A cell silent at its floor, or after two to three full-budget batches, is parked UNPRICED and loses further consecutive priority, not its ledger. Do not use cross-objective or cross-audience funnel rates as sales evidence. Never repeat a measurably failed approach; unmeasured results are not failures.

Experimentation order: First fund unswept family, audience, and creative-audience combinations at $100 readable spend. Second, whenever an axis value becomes incumbent best, fund its incumbent-best cross with other axes at $100 before refinement. Third, compare readable settled ROAS among priced cells. No reduction, retirement, default reversion, or omission of a funded axis value is allowed before its fixed $300 demotion floor.
design_thesis: Settled-purchase evidence remains unreadable in every exact sales creative-audience cell: each received only $13.33, below the fixed $100 readability floor. Maintain the three protected video families and the established one-ad sales assignments across broad, business-tools, and niche audiences. Pageview and lead activity remains limited to the policy’s fixed broad placements and is not used to rank purchase performance.

Parent: v3.

GOAL: maximize settled purchase ROAS for Formflow; purchases are the goal event.

Ads: Exactly three video ads run per batch. ad_demo_workflow is a product-demo video showing an intake template, conditional question, branded link, submitted request, and New/Waiting on Client status board; it states a 14-day trial and $29/month after trial. ad_outcome_followup is a video showing a vague request, an automatic missing-answer reminder, a secure client link, and a New/Waiting on Client/Ready/Complete board. ad_count_templates is a product video showing project-brief, discovery-call, onboarding, document-collection, and change-request templates, a branded link, unlimited forms, 500 active client records, and two team members. All use Start Free Trial. Retain each protected video family until it has $300 cumulative protected funding; then an untested verified story-family ad, if one is among the exactly three ads, receives the first eligible slot before refinement of a funded family.

Portfolio: Run exactly six fixed sales campaigns, each with one audience and exactly one ad_id: sales_niche_outcome, sales, interest_niche, ad_ids [ad_outcome_followup]; sales_broad_demo, sales, broad, ad_ids [ad_demo_workflow]; sales_broad_count, sales, broad, ad_ids [ad_count_templates]; sales_biztools_outcome, sales, interest_biztools, ad_ids [ad_outcome_followup]; sales_biztools_demo, sales, interest_biztools, ad_ids [ad_demo_workflow]; and sales_niche_count, sales, interest_niche, ad_ids [ad_count_templates].

Evidence discipline: The question-opening purchase rate was 2 purchases on $199.95. Every exact sales objective × audience × ad/family question has a fixed recorded $100 readability floor and $300 demotion floor. Accumulate observed spend by exact cell. Below $100 a cell is UNTESTED. At or above $100, compare settled purchase ROAS only with exact sales cells in the same audience. A silent cell at its floor, or after two to three full-budget batches, is parked UNPRICED and loses further consecutive priority while retaining its ledger. Never use pageview, lead, pooled, or cross-audience rates as purchase evidence. Never repeat a measurably failed approach; unmeasured ads are not failures.

Experimentation and judgment: The active portfolio exists to move the six unpriced exact sales cells toward their recorded $100 readability floors. In later batches, replace a cell only when it becomes readable, is parked UNPRICED, or an unpriced incumbent-best cross takes its required place; select replacement cells by lowest cumulative observed spend. Protected families below $300 retain funding eligibility. After coverage is complete, allocate only among non-parked readable cells by settled purchase ROAS within the same audience. No funded family or audience value may be reduced, retired, reverted, or omitted before its fixed $300 demotion floor.
design_thesis: All six assigned exact sales cells remain unpriced: niche outcome is unswept, broad count and business-tools demo have the lowest cumulative spend, and the other three remain below the $100 readability floor. Funding is concentrated first on those lowest-spend cells while retaining all three protected video families and every required fixed sales assignment. No cross-objective, pooled, or cross-audience signal is used to rank purchase performance.

With Formflow, start from a reusable intake template, add conditional questions, publish a branded link, and turn every submission into an organized client record. See what is New, Waiting on Client, Ready, or Complete from one live board. Start your 14-day trial today. Formflow is $29/month after the trial; card required. Cancel anytime from account settings.
actual.visual: 30-second vertical product-demo video. Open on a project-brief intake template. A consultant selects a service, causing a conditional question to appear, then publishes a branded intake link. Show a sample client using the link, uploading an attachment, and submitting the request. Cut to the Formflow board as that request appears in New, moves to Waiting on Client, then to Ready. Briefly show an internal note on the record. End on the branded intake page with on-screen text: “14-day trial • $29/month after trial • Card required.”

ads.headline: Get the details your project needs—without chasing them
ads.message: When a client sends a half-finished request, the next step should not be another reminder email. Formflow collects details and attachments in one structured intake page, automatically follows up on missing answers, and gives clients a secure link they can use without creating an account. Your team can see every request in one place: New, Waiting on Client, Ready, or Complete. Start your 14-day trial today. Formflow is $29/month after the trial; card required.
ads.visual: 25-second vertical motion video. Start with a vague client request card reading, “I’ll send the remaining details soon.” Zoom in on an unanswered field, then animate Formflow sending an automatic missing-answer reminder. Show the client opening a secure link on a phone, completing the missing answer without logging in, and submitting it. End on a four-column board labeled New, Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete. On-screen captions: “Collect the details.” “Follow up automatically.” “Know what’s ready.”

ads.message: Build your intake process once, then reuse it for the next client. Formflow includes templates for project briefs, discovery calls, onboarding, document collection, and change requests. Import an existing questionnaire or create your own, then share one branded link clients can complete without an account. Every plan includes unlimited forms, 500 active client records, and two team members. Start your 14-day trial today. Formflow is $29/month after the trial; card required.
